sheets.name: Cover
rows: AI-Assisted Contract Review Under ASC 606 | companion test workbook
Meridian Harbor Software, Inc. (fictional) | FY2026 Q4 close readiness | Fictional data

This is a training and portfolio sample. The entity, vendor, customers, people, contracts, amounts, test results and findings are fictional. The workbook supports the Markdown and PDF workpaper but does not replace it. Values are static: they were computed from the same data module that renders the workpaper, not by spreadsheet formulas.
25-contract test sample with model and reviewer results
16 risks, inherent and residual ratings, mapped to NIST AI 600-1
14 controls with objective, operation, owner, evidence and test result
Test method, sample size, exceptions and conclusion for each control
14 test cases: objective, expected behavior, actual result and conclusion
4 findings with condition, criteria, cause, effect and owner
3 observations that do not rise to a control finding
Remediation actions with owners, dates and closure evidence
6 actions to close the gaps before the Q4 close
16 evidence artifacts with format, retention, integrity and control linkage
Applicability decision and treatment for the 12 NIST AI 600-1 GenAI risks
Accuracy, agreement, correction and timing metrics
